Next TG5 meeting will be held on **Wednesday 28th of October**.
Link to the agenda: https://github.com/tc39/tg5/blob/main/agendas/2026/2026-10-28.md (_please note the unusual meeting times due to the fact that the U.S. and Europe switch from the Daylight Saving Time on different dates, namely October 25th and November 1st_)

_Please also note that there is no TG5 meeting in September, due to the TC39 Plenary Meeting held next week._
